== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (<code>1274_8</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 7.4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-05-Shadows_Of_The_Empire.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-shadowsoftheempire-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Agents Of Black Sun. Mistryl are lost. Once per game may ▲ Secret Plans. May use 3 Force to ▼ Imperial Square, and while Emperor Palpatine there, once per turn, may draw a card from Force Pile (and if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force). [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1274_8</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block set mark, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB7-05-Shadows_Of_The_Empire-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B12 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
